text: Việt Nam remains key market in SCG's regional manufacturing network

HÀ NỘI - Việt Nam is a key market in Thailand-based SCG's regional manufacturing network, generating revenue of more than VNĐ48.99 trillion (nearly US$1.86 billion) in the first nine months of 2026, the company said on Tuesday.

"Việt Nam remains an important part of SCG's long-term growth," President and Chief Executive Thammasak Sethaudom said, adding that the group would continue investing in projects, human resources and partnerships to support sustainable growth.

SCG is working to help Vietnamese small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) improve operational efficiency and competitiveness through knowledge-sharing initiatives and cooperation with government agencies, industry partners and local businesses, according to the group.
The group is also expanding production capacity and investing in technology to strengthen the competitiveness of Vietnamese manufacturers.
At Long Sơn Petrochemicals (LSP), SCG is advancing an ethane feedstock enhancement project, which is scheduled for completion in the second quarter of 2027, ahead of the previous timeline.
The project is expected to increase feedstock flexibility and strengthen the long-term competitiveness of the country's petrochemical industry.
LSP is also expected to resume operations in the second quarter of 2027.
At the group level, SCG reported a 19 per cent year-on-year increase in adjusted cash EBITDA to VNĐ45.34 trillion in the first nine months of 2026.

Group profit rose by 13 per cent, while sales revenue increased by 3 per cent from a year earlier, supported by business restructuring, operational improvements and growth in construction materials and packaging markets across Southeast Asia.

SCG said it had maintained its performance despite geopolitical tensions, volatile energy prices and challenging market conditions, while continuing to strengthen its financial position and improve operational efficiency through artificial intelligence and robotics. - VNS
